name: receipt-agent
description: Reads an uploaded receipt image or PDF and extracts the amount, date and merchant so the employee can confirm or edit them before submitting a claim. Calls no other component's API — it only reads the attachment it is given and returns structured fields. Never decides a claim's category or approval.

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Gates every call on the signed-in employee uploading a receipt.

dependencies.name: receipt-memory-db
dependencies.description: Server-held conversation store for the agent's own chat history.
